messages.content: is it normal to be this nervous before a placement interview? my hands literally shake lol
Yes, that's very common. Shaky hands usually settle once you start talking. A slow breath out before you walk in and some water nearby can help a bit.
aaj class mein bilkul mann nahi laga, main bahut thaki hui hoon. kal se phir wahi routine 😩
Aisa din hota hai jab body aur dimaag dono drained hote hain. Aaj ka bacha hua time bas aaram ko de do. Kal ke liye sirf ek chhota sa kaam choose kar lo, poora routine abhi sochne ki zaroorat nahi.
exam mein 12 din bache hain aur 3 subjects ka syllabus abhi bhi baaki hai. main bahut ghabra gaya hoon, samajh nahi aa raha kahan se shuru karu

12 din kaafi ho sakte hain agar order sahi ho. Pehle ye batao: 3 subjects mein se sabse weak kaunsa hai, aur kis mein marks sabse aasani se aa sakte hain? Uske hisaab se time baant lenge. Tab tak ek rough idea: roz do slots, ek weak subject ke liye aur ek revision ya easy subject ke liye.
weak wala Maths hai. par ek problem hai, ghar ki dukaan mein shaam ko 3-4 ghante baithna padta hai, toh padhai ka time kam ho jata hai

Ye important detail hai. Shaam ke 3-4 ghante nikal gaye, toh Maths ko subah ka time do, jab dimaag fresh hota hai. Ek simple split: subah Maths (practice zyada, theory kam), dopahar mein doosra subject, aur dukaan ke baad sirf 30-40 minute halka revision. Pehle 3 din ye chalake dekho, phir jo adjust karna ho wo dekh lenge. Subah ka kitna time free mil sakta hai?
ek ladka hai, 2 mahine se baat kar rahe hain, daily texting, calls bhi. par bolta hai label ke liye ready nahi hai. main bahut overthink kar rahi hoon
Arre, 2 mahine daily baat karne ke baad ye sunna, confuse toh hona hi tha. Tujhe zyada kya kha raha hai, ki wo serious hai ya nahi, ya ye ki tujhe khud kya chahiye?
dono. aur kal usne meri story pe react nahi kiya par kisi aur ki story pe kiya, toh mera dimaag kharab ho gaya

Haha okay, story wali cheez pe dimaag ghumna samajh aata hai, par sirf usse kuch prove nahi hota. Ho sakta hai usne dekhi hi na ho. Tu ye bata, label ke bina tujhe ye sab chalta hai, ya tujhe clarity chahiye?
sach bolun toh mujhe clarity chahiye. par dar lagta hai ki pooch lungi toh wo door chala jayega

Dar toh lagega hi, pooch ke kuch kho dene ka. Par sach bol, abhi bhi toh har choti baat pe tera dimaag laga hua hai, wo bhi toh tujhe thaka raha hai na. Seedha bol de, kuch aisa: 'Mujhe label ki jaldi nahi hai, bas jaanna hai ki tu aage ko lekar kya soch raha hai, kyunki mujhe clarity chahiye.' Uska jawab, aur wo kaise bolta hai, dono tujhe kaafi kuch bata denge. Anuman lagane se toh kuch pata nahi chalega. Aur jawab kuch bhi ho, clarity maangna galat nahi hai. Kab aur kaise bolna hai, wo tu decide kar. Chahe toh pehle yahin bol ke practice kar le, main hoon.
got my first job 4 months ago and I'm already dreading Mondays. everyone says be grateful. I am, but I'm also so drained

You can be grateful and drained at the same time, they don't cancel each other out. Four months in with Sunday-night dread sounds heavy. What's draining you most, the workload, the people, or the sameness of it?
workload mostly. I stay till 9 almost every day and my manager keeps adding stuff. been thinking of quitting but I have an education loan EMI so it feels stupid even thinking about it

It's not stupid to think about it. That feeling is worth taking seriously, and the EMI is a real constraint too. But 'quit tomorrow' and 'just survive' aren't the only two options. A middle path: track what you actually work on for a week so you have specifics, then tell your manager everything that's on your plate and ask which things take priority. And quietly refresh your resume, not to leave right now, just so you feel like you have a choice. Does your manager know you're at your desk till 9 most days?
shaadi mein ek rishtedaar bole 'kitna kamzor ho gaya hai, kuch khata nahi kya'. sabke saamne. main hans toh gaya par andar se bura laga

Sabke saamne aisa bolna sach mein cheap hota hai, aur hans ke tal dena andar ka bura aur bhi chubhta hai. Tumhara shareer sabke comments ke liye nahi hai, aur isme tumhari koi galti nahi. Ye comments tumhe aksar sunne padte hain, ya pehli baar hua?
hostel mein 4 dost the apne. aaj pata chala wo teeno movie gaye aur mujhe bataya hi nahi. kuch bol nahi paya, bas chup raha
Ye sunke bura lagna swabhavik hai, khaaskar jab wo apne hi dost hon. Tumhe sabse zyada kya chubha, ki chhod diya gaya, ya ki kisi ne bataya hi nahi?
dono. mujhe lagta hai unhe ab main boring lagta hoon. pichle hafte bhi maine plan cancel kiya tha padhai ki wajah se

Unke dimaag mein kya chal raha hai, ye humein nahi pata. Ho sakta hai bhool gaye hon, ho sakta hai koi aur wajah ho. Tum jo soch rahe ho wo ek possibility hai, fact nahi. Ek seedha tareeka: kisi ek se casual poocho, 'kal movie gaye the? mujhe bataya nahi', bina taane ke. Uska jawab tumhe zyada batayega. Aur agli baar ek plan tum khud bhi suggest kar sakte ho, taaki tum bahar na rahe.
placements ended and I got nothing. half my friends have offers. I can't even face them

That's a rough place to be, especially with everyone around you celebrating. Not wanting to face people makes sense when you're hurting. Do you want to talk about how it feels first, or figure out what's next?
what's next I guess. my parents took a loan for my fees so I need something fast. but I don't even know what I'm good at

Okay, let's go there. There are two separate things here: the 'something fast' part and the 'what am I good at' part. No need to solve both tonight. For fast: off-campus applications, referrals, short contracts or internships that can turn full-time. For the second, we can look at what you've actually done in college, like projects, clubs, things people asked you for help with. What's your branch, and was there anything you enjoyed even a little?
mechanical. I enjoyed the CAD project in 3rd year and our team presentation. honestly most of the rest felt boring

That's useful. CAD plus presenting well points towards roles where design and communication meet, but that's two data points, so treat it as a lead, not a conclusion. For the next two weeks: 1) turn your CAD project into a one-page portfolio with images, 2) look at design, drafting or product-support style roles and ask seniors or alumni for referrals, which usually work better than cold applications, 3) set a small daily quota, like 5 applications or 2 messages to alumni, so it feels doable. And with friends, you don't have to face anyone before you're ready. When you want to, a short 'still looking, will update' is enough. Want to draft the alumni message together first?
lecture mat dena pls. raat ke 3 baj gaye reels dekhte dekhte, subah 9 baje class hai. khud pe gussa aa raha hai
No lecture, promise. 3 baje tak reels aur upar se khud pe gussa, ugh, worst feeling hai ye. Abhi bas phone side mein rakho aur so jao. Class ka kal dekh lenge.
roz yahi hota hai. din bhar kuch sochne ka time nahi milta, toh raat ko hi dimaag khulta hai aur wahi se scroll shuru ho jata hai

Hmm, ye tumne khud pakda, good one. Matlab din bhar toh time hi nahi milta, aur raat ko jab sab shaant hota hai tabhi dimaag chalu hota hai, aur reels us se bhaagne ka easy tareeka ban jaate hain? Raat ko usually kya ghoomta rehta hai dimaag mein, ya kuch specific nahi hota? Ek chhoti si cheez try kar sakte ho: shaam ko 10 min notes mein bas sab dump kar do, jo bhi dimaag mein aaye. Dekho raat ko thoda halka lagta hai ya nahi.
mujhe dance bahut pasand hai, main chhupke practice karta tha. bhai ne ek baar video dekh li toh bola 'ye ladkiyon wale kaam hain'. tab se band kar diya
Jo cheez tumhe pasand thi, wo ek comment ki wajah se band karni padi, ye sunke bura laga. Dance kisi ek gender ka kaam nahi hota, ye bas tumhari pasand hai. Band karne ke baad kaisa lagta hai?
khaali sa. par dar bhi hai ki papa ko pata chala toh kya sochenge. wo toh engineering ke alawa kuch maante hi nahi

Khaali lagna samajh aata hai. Papa kya sochenge, ye abhi anuman hai, kyunki unse is baare mein baat hi nahi hui hai. Tumhe ek baar mein sab bolna zaroori nahi. Pehle ek chhota safe tareeka ho sakta hai: college mein dance club ya online classes, jahan tum ghar mein bataye bina shuru kar sako. Phir jab comfortable ho, ghar ko dheere dheere dikha sakte ho. Tumhare liye abhi kya zyada zaroori hai, dance wapas shuru karna ya ghar mein bolna?
